answer: A delta wharf keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must haul river stones by hand from the wharf up a distinct mesa path, one basket at a time. The first fake owes 2 stones, the second 6, the third 30, the fourth 210, since each new fake multiplies the last load by the next prime, so the tenth fake alone owes 6,469,693,230 stones and twenty together owe over five hundred septillion. Bulk farming fails because one porter carries one basket up one path and no cart hauls two loads at once, like one mule climbing one trail with one sack. Each stone is hauled fresh, never bought.
